what: baton_tui/drafts.py exactly as it shipped inside the released 1.0.0 console
why: The cross-version compatibility test needs the OLD READER: it must refuse a file the current console writes rather than misread it and publish a team notice to everyone. That evidence cannot live in the artifact being released -- the test used to read it out of the checked-in bin/baton-tui, which was the 1.0.0 console until the 1.1 build replaced it, after which the test loaded the NEW console and asserted that draft format 3 equals 1. It is not fetched from Git at test time either: a suite must run in an exported tree, a shallow clone, or a distribution with no history at all.
